title: Groom Club Monthly Late-Cancellation Charge: Club Visit Value
content:
*Billing desk entry — Tailwise Grooming Salon, Groom Club Monthly.*

**Amount.** The club late-cancellation charge is the value of one club visit, the price paid on the club divided by the club's included visits, rounded half up to the cent once on the final amount.

**Terms used**

- *Price paid on the club* — the price paid shown on the Groom Club Monthly record, that is the monthly fee for the pet's size class at purchase.
- *Included visits* — the visits Groom Club Monthly credits per billing month, as given on the salon rate card.
- *Rounding* — only the final amount is rounded, half up to the cent; half up means a figure lying exactly on a half cent goes to the higher cent, and a tolerance of 0.0001 cent is added to the final amount before rounding.

**Worked figures (hypothetical clubs)**

| Price paid on the club | Included visits per billing month | Club late-cancellation charge |
|---|---|---|
| 87.99 | 1 | 87.99 |
| 61.99 | 1 | 61.99 |
| 104.99 | 1 | 104.99 |
